scope.mundari_relevance: Article explicitly includes both Kera Mundari and Mundari among seven Munda languages. Item-level evidence must preserve which language/variety each form is assigned to.

canonicalization.rule: DOI, publisher page, Swarthmore repository record, bibliographic indexes, and lawful manuscript/copy manifestations represent one scholarly-work identity unless an independently substantive version is demonstrated.
canonicalization.duplicate_search_note: Repository code search for exact title returned no prior exact match before this audit.

evidence_promotion.reason: Exact article text, immutable permitted bytes/hash, printed/PDF-page concordance, and form-level source/dependency provenance have not yet been verified.

dependency_and_cultural_controls: Do not treat examples for seven languages as Mundari evidence without language/variety attribution.
Separate Kera Mundari from other Mundari varieties where the article does so.
Trace each promoted lexical/mimetic form to the article's cited source, fieldwork, consultant, dictionary, or prior publication where stated.
Do not infer community-wide cultural meaning from lexical semantics or sound-symbolic glosses.
Apply consent/privacy/cultural-access review to any underlying elicited or recorded material before redistribution.
